name: CreateOrUpdateContact

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert contact.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, a new alert contact is created.
*   If you specify this parameter, the specified alert contact is modified
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人ID。

- 不填代表创建新的告警联系人。
- 填写代表修改指定告警联系人信息
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert contact
parameters.name: contact_name

parameters.help_en:
The mobile number of the alert contact.

> You must specify at least one of the **Phone** and **Email** parameters. Each mobile number or email address can be used for only one alert contact
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人手机号码。

> **Phone**和**Email**参数至少填写一项。每个手机号码或邮箱只能用于一个联系人
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The email address of the alert contact.

> You must specify at least one of the **Phone** and **Email** parameters. Each mobile number or email address can be used for only one alert contact
parameters.help_zh:
告警联系人邮箱地址。
> **Phone**和**Email**参数至少填写一项。每个手机号码或邮箱只能用于一个联系人
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
The operation that you want to perform if phone calls fail to be answered. Valid values:

*   0: No operation is performed.
*   1: A phone call is made again.
*   2: A text message is sent.
*   3 (default value): The global default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
电话通知失败后，通知补发类型。

- 0：不补发
- 1：重复拨打一次电话
- 2：发送短信通知
- 3（默认）：使用全局默认值
parameters.name: reissue_send_notice

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the email address is verified
parameters.name: is_email_verify

parameters.help_en: The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot
parameters.name: ding_robot_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert contact that is shown to the enterprise when the contact is mentioned with the at sign (@) by a third-party instant messaging (IM) tool
parameters.help_zh: 告警联系人在自己企业组织内的标识，用于三方IM的@功能
